author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: ततः किम् जातमित्यत आह ॥ तमुवाचेति । हे भारतेति धृतराष्ट्रसम्बोधनम् । प्रहसन्निवेति परिहासकरवाक्योक्तिद्योतकहासस्य सूचनायेवशब्दः ॥ २.१०॥
translation: Sanjaya said: - Having thus spoken to Hrishikesa, Gudakesa, the terror of foes, said to Govinda "I will not fight, and became silent. 0 Bharata, Hrishikesa in a laughing mood spoke these words to him that (stood) despondent in the midst of the two armies. (9-10)
